summary: Pipedream released a developer playground for Connect that demonstrates the server API/SDK and the connect-react package. Updates include a Debug tab showing calls, payloads, and responses in real time; bug fixes and connect-react support for SQL and object prop types, plus improved string[] input UX; and a redesigned interface.
title: New Developer Playground for Pipedream Connect

summary: The September 25, 2026 update covers an Alegra resource ID format change now in effect, support for Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, an upcoming Gemini deprecation, and other app updates.
title: Alegra resource ID format change, Google Gemini AI model, and more app updates

summary: ZapConnect is a free, one-day virtual event on September 23 at 9 AM PT / 12 PM ET, featuring 30+ sessions and 50 speakers on AI automation, including keynotes, live build-alongs, governance playbooks, and discussions. Zappy Award nominations close July 24, 2026, and winners will be announced live at the event.
title: ZapConnect 2026 registration is open 🎉

summary: Version 0.91.1 includes fixes for subflow retries and connection references. The build fix moves MinIO off Docker Hub and removes source maps that the image build deletes.
n8n 2.38.1 was released on 2026-09-01. Its MongoDB node batches writes with bulkWrite, and the release includes nine other features.
title: n8n@2.38.1

summary: Zapier unveiled Next Gen Zaps, which can be built through AI tools or directly in Zapier using natural language, code, or a visual canvas. They add uncapped list processing, branching and nested loops, error handling, pauses and automatic resumption, and monitoring agents that can diagnose failures and apply or suggest fixes; early access is available to paid-plan users by request.
title: The next generation of Zaps is here

summary: The October 9, 2026 entry covers Make AI Agent fallback connections and prompt caching, new AI models Maia, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and GPT-6.1 Sol, SSO login routing, and MCP tools for audit logs.
title: Make AI Agent improvements, new AI models, SSO login routing, and MCP tools for audit logs

summary: n8n 2.39 was released on 2026-09-08. It adds online meeting support to the Microsoft Teams node and includes 16 other features.
title: n8n@2.39

summary: n8n 2.42 was released on 2026-09-29. It adds prompt caching support to the Anthropic node and includes 26 other features.
title: n8n@2.42
